slides.fact: An API serves developers. MCP tells an AI which tools exist and what each is for.

slides.myth: A connected tool is a safe tool
slides.fact: Connecting grants access. What the AI may change is a separate decision.

slides.myth: The AI will ask before anything risky
slides.fact: Only if someone built the gate. Check what your client asks about.

slides.text: Ask what it **can change**, not what it can do.
